name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5_Clinical-Trials_Matryoshka2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 2048). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (nomic_bert: BERT + rotary, GLU MLP)
notes: ADDED 2026-11-04. A full finetune of nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 (137M, identical tensor set, native 768 dim) with a MatryoshkaLoss wrapper over dims 768/512/256/128/64 - one checkpoint, not five models; only the 768 rows are recorded. NOT a duplicate of the catalog's existing nomic-embed-text-v1-5-clinical-trials-matryoshka-final: that record is the ...data_final run (7,079 pairs), this one is the ...data2 run (7,869 pairs), and the two cards' absolute numbers are not comparable to each other because the base was re-evaluated per corpus - the same 768-dim accuracy@1 baseline reads 0.432028 on data_final and 0.169143 on data2. Within THIS card the comparison is clean and same-harness: 'base_value | ft_value' columns, base re-run with the same InformationRetrievalEvaluator on the same 7,869 anchor/positive pairs, so +11.9pp accuracy@1 is a real in-domain delta. It is also entirely in-domain on clinical-trials text from a private corpus, not BEIR: expect the delta to shrink badly out of domain. One quirk worth knowing: the separate 'Information Retrieval' table on the same card prints a slightly different 768-dim accuracy@1 (0.2891) than the comparison table (0.288); the comparison table is the one recorded, since it is the one that carries the base column. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-25.

benchmarks.config: Card section 'Comparison with the baseline model performance on same data', columns 'metric | dimensions | base_value | ft_value': base_value 0.169143 vs ft_value 0.28800000000000003 at 768 dims. Native 768-dim output; InformationRetrievalEvaluator over the card's own clinical-trials anchor/positive corpus (dataset vab46/Clinical_trials_anchor-positive_pairs_EmbeddingModel-data2, 7,869 pairs), not a public BEIR task. Recorded x100 from the card's 0-1 value.
